summary: Senior Product Designer with a track record of building design systems that scale and shipping measurable improvements to user experience. At Zalando, I built and maintained a design system used by 40 product teams, cutting component duplication 62% and raising checkout accessibility to WCAG AA. At SoundCloud, I redesigned a core mobile flow and lifted completion 24%. I bring the same rigor to solving ambiguous, high-impact design problems at scale.
